purpose: Provider-neutral scoped discovery, creation, canonical binding and access.
use: Discovering, creating, binding or writing a repository, or committing and pushing: resolve provider-neutral scoped access before effects.
semantic_conditions: Inaccessible is never absent; no duplicate creation after 403, ambiguous 404 or timeout.
mandatory_preconditions: Four-state discovery result, selected credential and verified read/write capability.
postconditions_verification: Remote state read back; ref targeting and publication verified, not inferred from command success.
